general.abyssal_salt.cooldown_ticks.comment:
Ticks before you can eat another (20 = 1 second). Kept across relogs and death.
吃完多少刻以后才能再吃（20 = 1 秒）；退出重进、死亡都不清
Range: 0 ~ 144000

general.abyssal_salt.purge_max.comment:
Removes at most this much.
至多清掉多少
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

general.abyssal_salt.purge_min.comment:
Removes at least this much (never below 0).
至少清掉多少（不会清到 0 以下）
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

general.abyssal_salt.purge_ratio.comment:
Share of your current Hoanna radiation dose removed by one salt.
吃一颗清掉当前海纳尔辐射剂量的几成
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.ancient_scrolls.consume_on_read.comment:
Whether a scroll is used up when read (never in creative mode). Off: one scroll can be passed around the whole server.
读完是否消耗这张残卷（创造模式不消耗）。关掉后一张残卷可以传遍全服

general.ancient_scrolls.enabled.comment:
Whether scrolls drop at all (off: loot tables drop nothing and the research book hides the Scrolls chapter; scrolls already found can still be read).
是否掉落残卷（关掉后掉落表不再出残卷，研究手册的「古卷」整章藏掉；已经拿到的照样能读）

general.ancient_scrolls.read_ticks.comment:
How long to hold right-click to read a scroll, in ticks (20 = 1 second).
按住右键多少刻读完一卷（20 刻 = 1 秒）
Range: 1 ~ 200

general.ancient_scrolls.set_resistance.comment:
MRU corruption resistance and Hoanna radiation resistance given for good once all volumes are read (7, or 5 while Gates to Hoanna are disabled); added like an accessory's resistance. 0 = no reward.
读完全部残卷（7 卷，海纳尔之门关着时 5 卷）后永久增加的 MRU 腐化抗性和海纳尔辐射抗性，和饰品的抗性加在一起；0 = 没有奖励
Range: 0.0 ~ 0.4

general.attunement.budget_cap.comment:
Most budget that can be banked (720 = about two hours).
预算最多存多少（720 约等于两小时）
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

general.attunement.budget_per_hour.comment:
Attunement budget gained per hour online, for armor and weapons separately. The budget only limits how fast points come in, not where they come from.
每在线一小时攒多少同调预算（盔甲、武器各一份）。预算只限速，不限来源
Range: 0 ~ 100000

general.attunement.damage_per_stage.comment:
Weapon damage per stage, as a fraction (0.03 = x1.03 per stage).
武器每阶的攻击倍率（0.03 = 每阶 ×1.03）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.attunement.disabled_families.comment:
Attunement families turned off (for example "essentialcraft5:computer_armor", or just "computer_armor" for this mod's families): they gain no points and their stage-up recipes give nothing; stages already reached keep their effects.
关掉的同调家族（例 "essentialcraft5:computer_armor"，本模组的家族也可以只写 "computer_armor"）：不攒点、升阶配方不出产物；已有的阶效果照常

general.attunement.enabled.comment:
Attunement on. When off, no gear gains attunement points and no stage-up recipe gives a result; stages already reached keep their effects.
同调总开关。关掉时装备不再攒同调度、升阶配方不出产物；已有的阶效果照常

general.attunement.health_per_stage.comment:
Max health each armor piece adds per stage (2 = one heart).
盔甲每阶每件加的最大生命（2 = 一颗心）
Range: 0.0 ~ 20.0

general.attunement.points_boss_hit.comment:
Points for armor taking a hit from a boss.
盔甲挨首领一下给几点
Range: 0 ~ 10000

general.attunement.points_boss_kill.comment:
Extra points for a weapon killing a boss.
武器击杀首领另给几点
Range: 0 ~ 100000

general.attunement.points_hit.comment:
Points for armor taking a hit, or a weapon landing a hit.
盔甲挨一下、武器打实一下给几点
Range: 0 ~ 10000

general.attunement.points_kill.comment:
Extra points for a weapon landing the kill.
武器击杀另给几点
Range: 0 ~ 10000

general.attunement.points_pvp.comment:
Points when the other side is a player (0 = fights between players give nothing).
对面是玩家时给几点（0 = 玩家之间打不攒）
Range: 0 ~ 10000

general.attunement.pvp_effect_scale.comment:
Scale on durations, drains and bonus percentages of matrix affinities, matrix traits and attunement effects when the target is a player.
相性、矩阵特性、同调效果打在玩家身上时，时长、吸取和增伤百分比乘的倍数
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.attunement.rank_gate.comment:
Matrix rank needed for each stage (entry n = stage n + 1; 0 = no requirement). Ignored while matrix ranks are off.
升到每一阶要的矩阵阶（第 n 项 = 升到 n + 1 阶；0 = 不要求）。矩阵阶关掉时不看

general.attunement.thresholds.comment:
Attunement points needed to go from stage n to stage n + 1 (one entry per stage).
从 n 阶升 n + 1 阶要攒满的同调度（每阶一项）

general.bauble_limits.chi_xp_bonus.comment:
Chi Ring: picking up an experience orb gives this fraction of its value on top (the original mod used 1, i.e. double). Fractions are rounded randomly.
χ 指环：捡经验球时另给球上数值的这个比例（原作 1，即翻倍）；小数部分按几率进位
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.bauble_limits.epsilon_ember_chan.comment:
Epsilon Belt: chance of one extra random Ember when you kill a hostile mob yourself.
ε 腰带：亲手击杀敌对生物时多掉一个随机余烬的几率
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.bauble_limits.experience_ring_ub.comment:
Ring of Experience: every this many UBMRU it takes from a kill becomes 1 experience point (the original mod used 4).
经验指环：从击杀里拿走的 UBMRU 每多少点变成 1 点经验（原作 4）
Range: 1 ~ 100000

general.bauble_limits.mining_xp_ores_onl.comment:
Pi Belt and Rho Ring only work on blocks in #forge:ores. Off: any block that drops experience (spawners, sculk) counts, and the Pi Belt's bonus point can come from any block.
π 腰带、ρ 指环只认 #forge:ores 里的方块。关掉后所有掉经验的方块（刷怪笼、幽匿块）都算，π 的「没经验也给 1 点」对任何方块都掷

general.bauble_limits.nu_max_targets.comment:
Nu Amulet: at most this many hostile mobs are hit per kill (nearest first). Kills made by the Amulet itself never chain.
ν 护身符：每次击杀最多打几只周围的敌对生物（近的先）；护身符自己打死的不再连锁
Range: 0 ~ 64

general.bauble_limits.phi_cooldown_ticks.comment:
Phi Ring: minimum ticks between two shearings by the same player.
φ 指环：同一个玩家两次剪取之间至少隔几 tick
Range: 0 ~ 1200

general.bauble_limits.pi_xp_multiplier.comment:
Pi Belt: experience from mining ores (any block when mining_xp_ores_only is off) is multiplied by this (the original mod used 3). Fractions are rounded randomly.
π 腰带：挖矿石（关掉 mining_xp_ores_only 时为任何方块）掉的经验乘以这个数（原作 3）；小数部分按几率进位
Range: 1.0 ~ 3.0

general.bauble_limits.psi_affects_bosses.comment:
Psi Ring: also redirects bosses (#forge:bosses) to other hostile mobs, e.g. onto their own minions. What counts as a boss is the entity tag #forge:bosses; a datapack can add mobs to it.
ψ 指环：首领（#forge:bosses）盯上你时也改去打别的敌对生物（例如它自己召来的小怪）。哪些算首领以实体标签 #forge:bosses 为准，可以用数据包补

general.bauble_limits.psi_cooldown_ticks.comment:
Psi Ring: a mob is redirected to a new target at most once per this many ticks.
ψ 指环：同一只怪多少 tick 内最多换一次目标
Range: 1 ~ 1200

general.bauble_limits.rho_ubmru_per_xp.comment:
Rho Ring: UBMRU given per point of mining experience.
ρ 指环：挖方块的每点经验换多少 UBMRU
Range: 0 ~ 100000

general.bauble_limits.tau_affects_bosses.comment:
Tau Ring: also adds loot to bosses (#forge:bosses), e.g. extra Nether Stars from the Wither. What counts as a boss is the entity tag #forge:bosses; a datapack can add mobs to it.
τ 指环：对首领（#forge:bosses）也加掉落，例如凋灵多掉下界之星。哪些算首领以实体标签 #forge:bosses 为准，可以用数据包补

general.bauble_limits.theta_cooldown_tic.comment:
Theta Belt: after it stops a fatal hit, it does nothing for this many ticks (0 = no cooldown, as in the original mod).
θ 腰带：抵掉一次致命伤以后，这么多 tick 内不再生效（0 = 没有冷却，同原作）
Range: 0 ~ 72000

general.bauble_limits.xi_dose_ceiling.comment:
Xi Belt: radiation from its hits (on others) and from hits taken (by the wearer) never pushes a player's dose above this. 10000 dose = one level. 0 = it never irradiates players.
ξ 腰带：打人给的、戴着的人挨打吃的辐射，最多把剂量推到这么多（每 10000 一级；已经更高的不再加）。0 = 不给玩家加辐射
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

general.bauble_limits.xi_dose_per_hit.comment:
Xi Belt: at most this much radiation dose per hit on a player (5000 per point of damage before the cap).
ξ 腰带：打玩家每一下最多给对方多少辐射剂量（封顶前每点伤害 5000）
Range: 0 ~ 100000

general.baubles.disabled.comment:
Item ids listed here have no effect when worn and are not generated in dungeon chests.
Useful on PvP servers, e.g. ["essentialcraft5:zeta_amulet", "essentialcraft5:sigma_ring"].
列在这里的饰品（注册名）戴着不生效，也不会出现在地牢箱子里。PvP 服可以关 ζ、σ

general.builder.cells_per_tick.comment:
Blocks one wand may place, remove or swap per tick (blocks that need nothing done are not counted).
一根魔杖每刻最多放、拆、换几格（不用动的格子不算）
Range: 1 ~ 4096

general.builder.max_cells_per_tick_total.comment:
Blocks all wands on the server may change per tick together; shared evenly when several are working.
全服所有魔杖合计每刻最多改几格，几个人同时用时平分
Range: 1 ~ 16384

general.builder.max_point_distance.comment:
Largest straight-line distance between the two points, in blocks (the original's value).
两个点的直线距离上限（格，原作的值）
Range: 1 ~ 256

general.builder.max_reach.comment:
How close the player must stay to the selection, in blocks; walking farther away stops the work.
玩家离选区多远以内才能开工（格），施工途中走远了就停
Range: 1 ~ 256

general.builder.max_volume.comment:
Largest selection in blocks (the original had no limit, up to about 22000 at once).
选区最多几格（原作不限，最大约 2.2 万格、一刻做完）
Range: 1 ~ 32768

Radius of the arena around the summon point.
场地半径（以召唤点为中心）

Armor toughness.
护甲韧性

Once all pillars are down it uses two aspects at a time and swaps the pair this often.
四根都倒了以后每次用两相，每隔这么多刻换一对

general.calamity_heart.backlash_damage.comment:
Pillar Backlash (each pillar, the first time it drops to half health): flat damage around it (ignores armor).
灾柱反噬（每根第一次掉到一半时）：周围的人挨的固定伤害（无视护甲）

general.calamity_heart.backlash_radius.comment:
Pillar Backlash reaches this far from the pillar.
灾柱反噬打多远（以灾柱为中心）

general.calamity_heart.backlash_warning_.comment:

灾柱反噬预警多少刻

Shadow strikes during a Blackout.
熄光里几次暗袭
Range: 0 ~ 16

Ticks a Blackout lasts.
熄光多少刻

general.calamity_heart.blackout_warning_.comment:
Ticks of warning before a Blackout.
熄光预警多少刻

general.calamity_heart.breath_damage.comment:
Corrosive Breath: flat damage (ignores armor, 1 s warning).
腐蚀吐息：固定伤害（无视护甲，1 秒预警）

general.calamity_heart.breath_health_per.comment:
Corrosive Breath: plus this share of the target's max health.
腐蚀吐息：再加目标最大生命的这个比例
Range: 0.0 ~ 0.2

general.calamity_heart.breath_range.comment:
Corrosive Breath reaches this far.
腐蚀吐息够多远
Range: 1.0 ~ 32.0

general.calamity_heart.breath_warning_ti.comment:
Ticks of warning before the breath.
腐蚀吐息预警多少刻

general.calamity_heart.collapse_damage_t.comment:
Damage it takes while collapsing is multiplied by this.
崩解时挨打乘多少
Range: 1.0 ~ 4.0

general.calamity_heart.collapse_echo_int.comment:
Ticks between two Death Throes during a collapse countdown (alternating Fault rings and a Prism Volley; 0 = none).
崩解倒计时里每多少刻垂死反扑一次（交替断层和棱线齐射；0 = 不反扑）

Below this share of health it starts to collapse.
生命低于这个比例开始崩解

general.calamity_heart.collapse_ticks.comment:
Length of the collapse countdown.
崩解倒计时多少刻
Range: 20 ~ 12000

general.calamity_heart.combo_delay_ticks.comment:
Once all pillars are down, ticks after each new pair of aspects before their combined skill (0 = none).
四根都倒了以后，每换一对相过多少刻放这一对的合相技（0 = 不放）
Range: 0 ~ 12000

general.calamity_heart.converge_damage.comment:
Convergence (when the last pillar falls): flat damage to fighters outside the safe circle around it (ignores armor).
四灾归心（最后一根灾柱倒下时）：在它身边安全圈外的人挨的固定伤害（无视护甲）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1000.0

general.calamity_heart.converge_health_p.comment:
Convergence: plus this share of the target's max health.
四灾归心：再加目标最大生命的这个比例

四灾归心安全圈的半径

general.calamity_heart.converge_warning_.comment:
Ticks of warning before the Convergence lands.
四灾归心预警多少刻

general.calamity_heart.cores_extra_witho.comment:
Extra Shade Cores per summon while require_calamity is off.
关掉 require_calamity 时每次多吃几个暗影核心
Range: 0 ~ 64

general.calamity_heart.cores_per_resummo.comment:
Shade Cores a spent beacon costs per summon (a fresh beacon costs none).
空信标每召一次吃几个暗影核心（新合成的满信标第一次不吃）
Range: 0 ~ 64

general.calamity_heart.corrosion_ticks.comment:
Ticks of Corrosion (no healing) from the breath.
腐蚀吐息给的腐蚀（不能回血）多少刻

general.calamity_heart.dissipate_ticks.comment:
When a fight is lost, the boss fades away after this many ticks.
没打倒时多少刻后散去

Ticks the fumes from the Echo of Miasma last.
残响 · 弥漫的毒雾活多久

general.calamity_heart.enchant_seal.comment:
Calamity Seal: the enchantments on a fighter's gear stop working, in four parts each held by one pillar (Sun Array: helmet and chestplate; Earthquake: leggings and boots; Darkness: main hand; Miasma: off hand, curios and the rest of the inventory). 天灾封印：参战者身上物品的附魔分四处失效，每处由一根灾柱压着（日阵：头盔、胸甲；地震：护腿、靴子；黑暗：主手；毒雾：副手、饰品栏、背包里其余物品）。打倒灾柱解开它那一处，战斗一结束全部解开。诅咒不封；别的不想封的附魔加进附魔标签 essentialcraft5:calamity_seal_exempt

general.calamity_heart.escape_range.comment:
Fighters further than this leave the fight.
超过这么远退出战斗
Range: 8.0 ~ 256.0

general.calamity_heart.exclusive_radius.comment:
No summoning while another Heart of Calamity or Matrix Specter is this close.
这么远以内有别的天灾之心 / 矩阵之影时召不出来

general.calamity_heart.experience.comment:
Experience dropped.
掉多少经验
Range: 0 ~ 100000

general.calamity_heart.fault_rings.comment:
Rings in the Echo of the Fault.
残响 · 断层几圈
Range: 0 ~ 16

general.calamity_heart.first_kill_bonus.comment:
Extra Calamity Remnants for each player's first win.
每人第一次打倒多给几个天灾残核
Range: 0 ~ 64

general.calamity_heart.follow_speed.comment:
Blocks per tick it drifts toward the fighters once all pillars are down.
四根都倒了以后跟着参战者挪的速度（格 / 刻）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.calamity_heart.fume_ticks.comment:
Ticks a fume from Miasma lasts.
瘴云放出的毒雾活多久

general.calamity_heart.fumes_per_cast.comment:
Fumes per Miasma cast.
瘴云一次放几团

general.calamity_heart.intro_ticks.comment:
Length of the opening (it and its pillars cannot be hurt and do not attack meanwhile; 0 = no opening).
开场演出多少刻（这段时间它和灾柱打不动、不出招；0 = 没有开场）

general.calamity_heart.long_night_strike.comment:
Shadow strikes during the Long Night.
残响 · 长夜几次暗袭

残响 · 长夜多少刻

Height above the ground while its shield is down.
破盾、失衡期、崩解时离地几格

general.calamity_heart.main_pillar_healt.comment:
Health of the pillar of the main calamity.
主灾那根灾柱的生命

烈日标记：落下那一刻你头顶上方 2 格还看得见天，挨最大生命的这个比例

general.calamity_heart.mark_warning_tick.comment:

烈日标记多少刻后落下

general.calamity_heart.max_fumes.comment:
Poison fumes it keeps at once (the Echo of Miasma adds as many again).
毒雾同时最多几团（残响 · 弥漫另放一份同样多的）

general.calamity_heart.max_prisms.comment:
Prism Lines at once.
天光棱线同时最多几条

general.calamity_heart.max_rubble.comment:
Falling rocks at once.
落石同时最多几块
Range: 0 ~ 32

general.calamity_heart.max_unevenness.comment:
The 25 sampled columns may differ in height by at most this much.
抽的 25 列地面最高最低差不超过多少

Echo of Noon: share of max health for every fighter under open sky.
残响 · 正午：露天的参战者挨最大生命的这个比例
Range: 0.0 ~ 0.2

general.calamity_heart.noon_warning_tick.comment:
Ticks of warning before the Echo of Noon.
残响 · 正午预警多少刻

general.calamity_heart.pillar_per_hit_ca.comment:

灾柱的单次封顶（0 = 不封）

general.calamity_heart.prism_damage.comment:
Prism Line: flat damage (sunlight, ignores armor, 1.5 s gold warning line).
天光棱线：固定伤害（日光，无视护甲，1.5 秒地面金线预警）

general.calamity_heart.prism_fire_second.comment:
Seconds a Prism Line sets you on fire.
天光棱线打中后着火几秒

general.calamity_heart.prism_health_perc.comment:
Prism Line: plus this share of the target's max health.
天光棱线：再加目标最大生命的这个比例
Range: 0.0 ~ 0.2

general.calamity_heart.prism_lines.comment:
Prism Lines per cast.
天光棱线一次几条
Range: 0 ~ 8

general.calamity_heart.prism_warning_tic.comment:
Ticks of warning before a Prism Line strikes.
天光棱线预警多少刻
Range: 1 ~ 200

general.calamity_heart.pull_range.comment:
Fighters further than this from the summon point are pulled back; players within this distance of it can hurt it. 0 = never pull, and then escape_range sets how close you must be.
参战者离召唤点超过这么远被拽回，离它这么远以内才打得动它。0 = 不拽，这时按 escape_range 算
Range: 0.0 ~ 128.0

general.calamity_heart.pulse_damage.comment:
Pulse: flat damage (ignores armor).
脉冲：固定伤害（无视护甲）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1000.0

general.calamity_heart.pulse_health_perc.comment:
Pulse: plus this share of the target's max health.
脉冲：再加目标最大生命的这个比例
Range: 0.0 ~ 0.2

general.calamity_heart.pulse_interval.comment:
Ticks between two pulses while collapsing.
崩解时每多少刻一次脉冲
Range: 10 ~ 1200

general.calamity_heart.pulse_range.comment:
Pulses hit fighters within this distance.
脉冲打多远以内的参战者
Range: 1.0 ~ 64.0

general.calamity_heart.quake_damage.comment:
Shockwave: flat damage if you are on the ground when a ring passes (ignores armor).
震波：圈扫过时你脚踩地面就挨的固定伤害（无视护甲）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1000.0

general.calamity_heart.quake_health_perc.comment:
Shockwave: plus this share of the target's max health.
震波：再加目标最大生命的这个比例
Range: 0.0 ~ 0.2

general.calamity_heart.quake_rings.comment:
Rings per Shockwave.
震波一次几圈
Range: 0 ~ 16

general.calamity_heart.require_calamity.comment:
Only summonable while Hoanna has a calamity (ley storms count). Off = a random main calamity, and every summon costs cores_extra_without_calamity more Shade Cores. If calamities can never start on their own (general.hoanna_events.chance_multiplier = 0, or every calamity turned off), this counts as off.
要海纳尔此刻有天灾（含地脉风暴）才召得出来。关掉时主灾随机，每次多吃 cores_extra_without_calamity 个暗影核心。天灾不会自己发生时（general.hoanna_events.chance_multiplier 为 0，或者天灾全关了）按关掉处理

general.calamity_heart.reraise_health.comment:
When the first countdown runs out it goes back to this share of health.
第一次倒计时走完回到生命的这个比例
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.calamity_heart.reraise_pillars.comment:
Pillars raised again when the first countdown runs out (only once).
第一次倒计时走完重立几根灾柱（只一次）
Range: 0 ~ 4

general.calamity_heart.reseal_on_reraise.comment:
Pillars raised again after the first collapse seal their part again.
崩解后重立的灾柱把它那一处重新封上

general.calamity_heart.ring_warning_tick.comment:
Ticks of warning before each ring rolls out.
每圈震波的预警刻数
Range: 1 ~ 200

general.calamity_heart.rubble_count.comment:
Falling rocks per cast.
落石一次几块
Range: 0 ~ 32

general.calamity_heart.rubble_damage.comment:
Damage of a falling rock (reduced by armor; its shadow warns you).
落石一块的伤害（吃护甲，地上先有影子）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1000.0

general.calamity_heart.rubble_warning_ti.comment:
Ticks a rock's shadow shows before it falls.
落石的影子多少刻后落下
Range: 1 ~ 200

general.calamity_heart.shield_hover.comment:
Height above the ground while any pillar stands.
护盾期悬在地面上几格
Range: 0.0 ~ 16.0

general.calamity_heart.shield_window_tic.comment:
Ticks its shield stays down after a pillar falls.
打掉一根灾柱以后破盾多少刻
Range: 0 ~ 6000

general.calamity_heart.skill_interval.comment:
Minimum ticks between two skills.
两个招式之间至少隔几刻
Range: 10 ~ 100000

general.calamity_heart.strike_damage.comment:
Damage of a shadow strike (reduced by armor). Holding a light source shows its path.
暗袭一下的伤害（吃护甲）；手里拿着光源看得见它的轨迹
Range: 0.0 ~ 1000.0

general.calamity_heart.strike_warning_ti.comment:
Ticks between a shadow strike's wind-up and its hit (step out of its path).
暗袭从起手到落下几刻（躲开轨迹就不挨）
Range: 1 ~ 100

general.calamity_heart.unbalanced_cooldo.comment:
Cooldown multiplier once all pillars are down.
四根都倒了以后冷却乘多少
Range: 0.1 ~ 1.0

general.calamity_heart.volley_lines.comment:
Prism Lines in a Prism Volley.
棱线齐射一次几条
Range: 0 ~ 16

general.computer_armor.armor_boots.comment:
Armor points of the boots.
靴子的护甲值
Range: 0.0 ~ 30.0

general.computer_armor.armor_chestplate.comment:
Armor points of the chestplate.
胸甲的护甲值
Range: 0.0 ~ 30.0

general.computer_armor.armor_helmet.comment:
Armor points of the helmet (vanilla caps a player's total armor at 30).
头盔的护甲值（原版玩家的总护甲最多算 30）
Range: 0.0 ~ 30.0

general.computer_armor.armor_leggings.comment:
Armor points of the leggings.
护腿的护甲值
Range: 0.0 ~ 30.0

general.computer_armor.chestplate_max_he.comment:
Extra max health of the chestplate, in health points.
胸甲加的最大生命（生命值）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1024.0

general.computer_armor.dash_cooldown.comment:
Full set boost: cooldown in ticks.
全套喷射推进：冷却（刻）
Range: 1 ~ 1200

general.computer_armor.dash_mru.comment:
Full set boost: MRU spent per boost (0 = free).
全套喷射推进：每次花多少 MRU（0 = 不花）
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

general.computer_armor.dash_strength.comment:
Full set boost: speed in the looking direction, blocks per tick.
全套喷射推进：朝视线方向的速度（格 / 刻）
Range: 0.0 ~ 10.0

general.computer_armor.helmet_saturation.comment:
Whether the helmet also keeps saturation full (fast regeneration), not only the hunger bar.
头盔是否也把饱和度顶满（回血很快），关掉时只保持饥饿值满

general.computer_armor.knockback_resista.comment:
Knockback resistance of each piece (0 to 1; 1 = immune).
每件的击退抗性（0~1，1 = 完全不被击退）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.computer_armor.leggings_jump.comment:
Extra upward speed when jumping with the leggings (a normal jump is 0.42).
穿护腿起跳时额外的竖直速度（普通起跳 0.42）
Range: 0.0 ~ 2.0

general.computer_armor.leggings_speed.comment:
Movement speed added by the leggings (a player's base speed is 0.1).
护腿加的移速（玩家基础移速 0.1）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.computer_armor.magic_price_multi.comment:
Attunement stage 2+: magic damage from a non-player attacker is blocked too, at this many times the cost per point.
同调 2 阶起：也挡非玩家攻击者打来的魔法伤害，每点单价乘这么多
Range: 0.0 ~ 1000.0

general.computer_armor.max_health.comment:
Extra max health of the helmet, the leggings and the boots, each, in health points (2 = one heart).
头盔、护腿、靴子每件加的最大生命（生命值，2 = 一颗心）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1024.0

general.computer_armor.max_mru.comment:
MRU stored by each piece.
每件存多少 MRU
Range: 1 ~ 100000000

general.computer_armor.mru_per_damage.comment:
MRU spent per point of damage a charged piece blocks (each piece counts at least 1 point).
有电的一件每挡下 1 点伤害花多少 MRU（每件至少按 1 点算）
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

general.computer_armor.overload_cooldown.comment:
Overload Barrier: cooldown in ticks (kept across relogging).
过载屏障：冷却多少刻（退出重进不清）
Range: 0 ~ 72000

general.computer_armor.overload_duration.comment:
Overload Barrier: ticks of immunity (anything that does not bypass invulnerability).
过载屏障：免疫多少刻（不无视无敌的伤害都免）
Range: 0 ~ 1200

general.computer_armor.overload_threshol.comment:
Overload Barrier (full set at stage 5): opens when the shield blocks at least this fraction of max health in one hit.
过载屏障（全套 5 阶）：护盾一下挡下的伤害至少是最大生命 × 这个比例时展开（0.25 = 四分之一）
Range: 0.0 ~ 100.0

general.computer_armor.piercing_price_mu.comment:
Attunement stage 4+: cost per point multiplier for armor-piercing damage.
同调 4 阶起：挡无视护甲伤害时每点单价乘这么多
Range: 0.0 ~ 1000.0

general.computer_armor.piercing_share.comment:
Attunement stage 4+: armor-piercing damage (not magic) from a non-player attacker is blocked at this fraction of each piece's share.
同调 4 阶起：非玩家攻击者打来的无视护甲伤害（不是魔法）每件挡自己份额的比例（0.5 = 一半）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.computer_armor.pvp_shield_cost_m.comment:
When the attacker is another player, cost per point multiplier.
攻击者是别的玩家时，每点单价乘这么多
Range: 0.0 ~ 1000.0

general.computer_armor.pvp_shield_max_sh.comment:
When the attacker is another player, each piece blocks at most this fraction of its share (the whole suit blocks at most this fraction of the hit).
攻击者是别的玩家时，每件最多挡自己份额的比例（整套合计就是这一下最多挡的比例，0.5 = 一半）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.computer_armor.repair_delay.comment:
Matrix Repair (full set at stage 3): ticks without taking damage before healing starts.
矩阵修复（全套 3 阶）：多少刻没受伤以后开始回血
Range: 1 ~ 72000

general.computer_armor.repair_mru_per_he.comment:
Matrix Repair: MRU spent per health point healed.
矩阵修复：每回 1 点生命花多少 MRU
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

general.computer_armor.repair_percent.comment:
Matrix Repair: fraction of max health healed per second.
矩阵修复：每秒回最大生命的比例（0.01 = 1%）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.computer_armor.shield_scope.comment:
Which damage a charged piece blocks its share of: ALL (anything that does not bypass armor), PHYSICAL_ELEMENTAL (melee, projectiles, fire, explosions, lightning, freezing; vanilla freezing bypasses armor) or PHYSICAL (melee and projectiles).
有电时挡哪些伤害：ALL（所有不无视护甲的）、PHYSICAL_ELEMENTAL（近战、弹射物、火、爆炸、闪电、冰冻；原版冻伤无视护甲，实际挡不到）、PHYSICAL（近战和弹射物）
Allowed Values: ALL, PHYSICAL_ELEMENTAL, PHYSICAL

general.computer_armor.stage_price_multi.comment:
Attunement: multiplier on the per-point shield cost at each stage, stage 0 first (missing stages use the last entry).
同调：护盾每点单价按阶乘几，从 0 阶起（缺的阶按最后一项）

general.computer_armor.swim_speed.comment:
Full set: swim speed added (forge:swim_speed, base 1).
全套：游泳速度加成（forge:swim_speed，基础 1）
Range: 0.0 ~ 16.0

general.computer_armor.thorns_ratio.comment:
Full set: share of the damage taken that is returned to the attacker (results under 0.5 are dropped).
全套：受到的伤害按这个比例反给攻击者（不到 0.5 点不反）
Range: 0.0 ~ 10.0

general.computer_armor.toughness.comment:
Armor toughness of each piece (vanilla caps the total at 20).
每件的盔甲韧性（原版总韧性最多算 20）
Range: 0.0 ~ 20.0

general.computer_board.fly_speed.comment:
Flying speed given by the board (vanilla creative flight is 0.05).
反重力板给的飞行速度（原版创造模式飞行 0.05）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.computer_modules.accumulator.for.comment:
Stored damage is lost after this many ticks without another swallowed hit on the same target.
同一个目标这么多刻（tick）没再记账，这笔账作废
Range: 1 ~ 1200

general.computer_modules.accumulator.max.comment:
How many targets one player can hold stored damage on at once (the oldest is dropped).
每名玩家最多同时记几个目标的账（满了丢最久没记账的）
Range: 1 ~ 256

At most this many times the landing hit's own damage is added (1.0 = the hit can at most double).
结算时最多补上这一下伤害的几倍（1.0 = 最多翻一倍）
Range: 0.0 ~ 10.0

general.computer_modules.attraction.inte.comment:
Ticks between two pulls (20 = 1 second). When radius is above 8, at least 10 ticks are used whatever this says.
每隔多少刻推一次（20 = 1 秒）；radius 超过 8 时不管这里写多少，实际至少 10 刻一次

general.computer_modules.attraction.mru_.comment:

开着时每秒耗的 MRU（模块每秒统一扣电时一起扣）

general.computer_modules.attraction.radi.comment:
Horizontal reach in blocks around the wearer; vertically it reaches 6 blocks down and 7 up, like the Magnetizing Staff.
水平范围（格）；竖直方向照磁化法杖，脚下 6 格到脚上 7 格

general.computer_modules.disabled.comment:
Module ids listed here cannot be installed, and have no effect and cost no MRU while already installed; they can still be removed.
e.g. ["essentialcraft5:rewind_module"] on PvP servers.
列在这里的模块（注册名）装不上；已经装着的不生效、不耗电，照常能拆。PvP 服可以关回溯，例 ["essentialcraft5:rewind_module"]

general.computer_modules.matrix_filter.m.comment:
Matrix damage per second of duration × (amplifier + 1) for each blocked effect (instant effects count as 1 second). An effect is only blocked if all of its matrix damage still fits under the cap.
拦下一个效果：每秒持续时间 ×（等级 + 1）记多少矩阵损伤（瞬间效果按 1 秒）；记不下这个效果的全部损伤时就不拦
Range: 0 ~ 100000

MRU spent per newly blocked effect; the same effect arriving again while already blocked costs no MRU (only the extra duration is added as matrix damage). Not blocked if you can't pay.
每拦下一个新效果花多少 MRU；同一个效果在已拦下的时间里再来不收 MRU（超出的那段时间照记矩阵损伤）；付不起就不拦
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

general.computer_modules.matrix_shunt.ma.comment:
Matrix damage for shunted damage equal to your whole max health; scales with the share of max health (2000 = 100 per point at the vanilla 20 max health, 20 per 1% of max health at any health).
分流掉的伤害正好等于自己的最大生命时记多少矩阵损伤，按占最大生命的比例折算（2000 = 原版 20 点生命时每点 100；不论多少血，分走最大生命的 1% 记 20）
Range: 0 ~ 2000000

general.computer_modules.matrix_shunt.ra.comment:
Share of each magic damage that is shunted (only as much as still fits under the matrix damage cap).
每次魔法伤害分流掉的比例（只分流矩阵损伤还记得下的那部分）
Range: 0.0 ~ 0.9

general.computer_modules.phase_anchor.af.comment:
Whether players who recently traded blows with the wearer are anchored too.
是否也锚住最近和穿戴者互相交过手的玩家

general.computer_modules.phase_anchor.co.comment:
Both players must have had an attack on each other that wasn't stopped (a hit, or one fully blocked by a shield or armor) within this many ticks.
双方都要在这么多刻（tick）内对对方有过一下没被拦下的攻击（打中了，或者被盾牌、盔甲整下挡掉都算）
Range: 20 ~ 1200

general.computer_modules.phase_anchor.ef.comment:
Ticks of Anchored given each time; must outlast the one-second check.
每次挂的锚定时长（刻），要比每秒一次的检查长
Range: 22 ~ 600

general.computer_modules.phase_anchor.mr.comment:
MRU per second while the module is on (paid by the module upkeep once a second).
开着时每秒耗的 MRU（模块每秒统一扣电时一起扣）
Range: 0 ~ 100000

general.computer_modules.phase_anchor.ra.comment:
Half-size in blocks of the cube around the wearer that is checked once a second.
以穿戴者为中心、每秒查一次的立方半径（格）
Range: 1 ~ 32

general.computer_modules.require_full_se.comment:
Whether modules only work while all four pieces of the suit are worn (otherwise each worn piece's modules work on their own).
是否要穿齐四件模块才生效（关掉时穿着哪件，哪件上的模块就生效）

general.computer_modules.rewind.cooldown.comment:
Cooldown after a rewind, in ticks; kept across relogs and deaths.
救下一次以后的冷却（刻），退出重进、死了都不清
Range: 0 ~ 1728000

general.computer_modules.rewind.matrix_d.comment:
Matrix damage added per rewind (capped by general.corruption.max_matrix_damage).
每救一次加多少矩阵损伤（不超过 general.corruption.max_matrix_damage）
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

general.computer_modules.rewind.min_age_.comment:
Only positions at least this many ticks old are used (20 = 1 second).
只用至少这么多刻以前的位置（20 = 1 秒）
Range: 0 ~ 600

general.computer_modules.rewind.mru_cost.comment:
MRU spent per rewind (MRU storages you carry first, then the chestplate's own MRU). Spent only when the rewind happens.
每救一次花多少 MRU（先扣身上的储存物品，凑不够再扣胸甲自己存的）；救成了才扣
Range: 0 ~ 100000000

general.computer_modules.rewind.rescue_v.comment:
Whether falling out of the world is rescued too. /kill never is.
掉进虚空摔死的救不救；/kill 一律不救

general.computer_modules.rewind.seconds_.comment:
Roughly how many seconds back you are sent. One position is remembered per second (in memory only), the last seconds_back × 2 are kept.
大约退回几秒前。每秒记一个位置（只在内存里），留最近 seconds_back × 2 个
Range: 1 ~ 30

general.computer_modules.shred.armor_per.comment:
Armor removed per level of Armor Shred (also used by Armor Shred from any other source).
每层破甲扣的护甲（别的来源加的破甲也按这个算）
Range: 0.0 ~ 20.0

general.computer_modules.shred.duration_.comment:
Ticks before all levels wear off if no new hit lands (refreshed on every hit).
多少刻（tick）没再叠就全部消失（每打实一下重新计时）
Range: 1 ~ 6000

general.computer_modules.shred.max_level.comment:
Highest level the Shred Module stacks Armor Shred to.
削减模块最多叠到几层
Range: 1 ~ 10

general.computer_modules.shred.toughness.comment:
Armor toughness removed per level of Armor Shred.
每层破甲扣的盔甲韧性
Range: 0.0 ~ 20.0

general.computer_modules.slots_boots.comment:
Module slots of the boots.
靴子的模块槽
Range: 0 ~ 4

general.computer_modules.slots_chestplat.comment:
Module slots of the chestplate.
胸甲的模块槽
Range: 0 ~ 4

general.computer_modules.slots_helmet.comment:
Module slots of the helmet.
头盔的模块槽
Range: 0 ~ 4

general.computer_modules.slots_leggings.comment:
Module slots of the leggings.
护腿的模块槽
Range: 0 ~ 4

general.computer_modules.stride.mru_per_.comment:
MRU per second while the module is on.
开着时每秒耗的 MRU
Range: 0 ~ 10000

general.computer_modules.stride.step_bon.comment:
Blocks added to the step height, on top of vanilla's 0.6 and the 0.6 the suit's boots already give (0.4 = 1.6 blocks in total).
步高加多少格，加在原版 0.6 和宅男靴子自带的 0.6 上面（0.4 = 合计 1.6 格）
Range: 0.0 ~ 2.0

general.computer_modules.veil.mru_per_se.comment:
MRU per second while the module is on.
开着时每秒耗的 MRU
Range: 0 ~ 10000

general.computer_modules.veil.multiplier.comment:
Multiplier on the distance at which mobs notice you.
怪物发现你的距离乘多少
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.computer_modules.veil.sneak_mult.comment:
Used instead of multiplier while sneaking (vanilla sneaking's own x0.8 still applies on top).
潜行时改乘这个（原版潜行自带的 × 0.8 照样连乘）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.computer_seal.affects_self.comment:
Whether the wearer's own Curios items are sealed too while the field is running.
运转时穿戴者自己的饰品是否一起失效

general.computer_seal.combat_window_tick.comment:
How long a hit between the two counts as "recently fought", in ticks.
一下交手记录的有效期（刻）
Range: 20 ~ 1200

general.computer_seal.disabled_dimension.comment:
Dimensions where the field does nothing: no one is sealed and no power is used. An entry with a colon matches that exact dimension id; one without matches any dimension with that path ("zc" matches minecraft:zc).
封禁场不起作用的维度：谁都不压制、也不耗电。带冒号的按完整 id 比，不带冒号的按路径比（"zc" 对得上 minecraft:zc）

general.computer_seal.enabled.comment:
Whether the Curio Seal Field exists at all.
整个功能开关

general.computer_seal.evaluate_interval.comment:
How often each wearer's field is evaluated, in ticks.
每名穿戴者多少刻评估一次
Range: 10 ~ 100

general.computer_seal.max_probes_per_tic.comment:
Claim probes a wearer may start per evaluation (new positions only; results are cached).
每名穿戴者每次评估最多新探测几格（只算新格子，结果有缓存）
Range: 1 ~ 64

general.computer_seal.min_hold_ticks.comment:
Minimum time a player stays sealed, in ticks.
被压制后最少保持多久（刻）
Range: 20 ~ 1200

general.computer_seal.mru_base.comment:
MRU per second while the field is running.
运转时每秒的基础花费（MRU）
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

general.computer_seal.mru_per_target.comment:
Extra MRU per second for each other player sealed.
每压制一名别的玩家，每秒加多少 MRU

After gaining an effect, minutes of play before the next one can be gained (draws are rolled once per minute online). 0 = every minute, as in the original.
抽中一个效果以后，至少再过多少分钟（在线时间，每分钟抽一次）才可能抽中下一个。0 = 照原作每分钟都可能抽中

general.corruption.draw_requires_cure_ti.comment:
Effects are only drawn for players who have opened a complete Soul Pentacle (any tier) at least once; from then on every

玩家打开过一次成形的灵魂五芒星（哪一档都行）以后才会抽到效果，之后所有类别（含矩阵类）都可能抽到；没打开过的不抽、已有的效果潜伏不发作；
按现在的柱子容量哪一档都治不了的效果同样不抽。关掉 = 照原作什么都抽

Matrix damage needed to draw an effect = its cost x this (the cost is still what the Soul Pentacle charges to cure it);
drawing one also uses up that much damage. Raise it to make effects rarer and the damage bar matter more.
抽到一个效果要攒多少矩阵损伤 = 它的成本 × 这个数（成本还是五芒星治它的 ESPE 价）；抽中时扣掉的也是这么多。调大 = 效果更难出、损伤更值得防

general.corruption.effect_chance_multipl.comment:
Multiplier on how often effects the player has trigger (each effect's per-second chance, capped at 1).
身上的效果发作得多勤：每种效果每秒发作概率 × 这个数（封顶 1）

general.corruption.effect_damage_multipl.comment:
Multiplier on the health taken by effects (on top of the *_health_percent values below; the MRU Corruption status

效果扣血的倍率（乘在下面各项 *_health_percent 之上；机器泄漏叠的「MRU 腐化」状态不是腐化效果，不乘）。一下最多扣到整条最大生命
Range: 0.0 ~ 10.0

general.corruption.effects_enabled.comment:

玩家会不会得到腐化效果、已有的效果会不会触发

general.corruption.gentle_effects.comment:

#13 takes at most half of the current health from the player and spares tamed animals and villagers.
温和的后果：#8 只打乱快捷栏；#9 把主手那一组收进背包，不扔在地上；#10 只是手抽一下（打断正在用的东西），不替你使用手里的东西；
#13 炸自己最多掉当前生命的一半，不伤驯服的动物和村民

海纳尔之门关着（general.hoanna.portal_enabled）时 2、3 档的虚空材料拿不到，矩阵类也一并不抽、不发作

general.corruption.max_matrix_damage.comment:
Matrix damage stops growing at this value (it is also the full bar in the Soul Pentacle screen). It should be at least the

2147483647 = no limit, as in the original.
矩阵损伤最多攒到多少（也是五芒星界面损伤条的满格）。至少要有最贵效果的门槛（成本 × draw_threshold_multiplier，默认 216000），
否则最贵的几种永远抽不到。2147483647 = 照原作不封顶

general.corruption.moonlight_health_perc.comment:
#17 The moon hurts: magic damage under a full moon; gibbous 3/5, quarter 2/5, crescent 1/5 of it, new moon none. A fraction of the victim's current max health (0.075 = 7.5%). Resistance and Protection enchantments reduce it as usual; armour only reduces the cactus, lightning and explosion ones (drowning, fire, magic and wither damage ignore armour, as in vanilla).
#17 月光刺痛：满月时的魔法伤害；凸月 3/5、半月 2/5、蛾眉月 1/5，新月不疼。按受害者当前最大生命的比例（0.075 = 7.5%）。抗性提升、保护附魔照常减免；护甲只减仙人掌、闪电、爆炸这几种（溺水、着火、魔法、凋零伤害照原版不吃护甲）

同一只恶魔两次清怪之间隔多少 tick（每次打一只）

恶魔清怪的范围（以它为中心往外几格）；0 = 不清怪

清怪时在怪脚下爆炸的威力（原作 2；0 = 不爆炸）。不破坏方块，只伤恶魔本来就会打的那类怪

general.ember_inlay.anvil_levels.comment:
Experience levels the anvil charges for inlaying (an old inlay is replaced, not returned).
在铁砧上嵌一次花多少级经验（旧的嵌片被换掉，不退）

铁砧能不能嵌、已经嵌好的武器触不触发效果

MRU spent per landed hit (taken from MRU storages you carry). Not enough MRU = no effect; the damage is never changed.
每次打实扣多少 MRU（从身上的储存物品扣）；扣不起就不触发，伤害本身从不改变

general.essential_tools.felling_radius.comment:
Axe: horizontal reach of the tree search, in blocks from the chopped log.
源质斧：找树的水平范围（离你砍的那根几格以内）
Range: 1 ~ 16

general.essential_tools.hardness_margin.comment:
Pickaxe: a surrounding block is mined only if its hardness is at most the center block's hardness plus this (stone 1.5, obsidian 50).
源质镐：邻格的硬度最多比中心那格高多少才一起挖（石头 1.5、黑曜石 50）
Range: 0.0 ~ 100.0

general.essential_tools.leaves_required.comment:
Axe: natural leaves (or nether wart blocks) that must touch the logs for the whole tree to fall; otherwise only the chopped log breaks. 0 = no check.
源质斧：原木周围至少有几片天然树叶（或下界疣块 / 诡异疣块）才整棵砍倒，否则只砍你砍的那根；0 = 不查
Range: 0 ~ 64

general.essential_tools.logs_per_tick.comment:
Axe: most logs one felling cuts per tick.
源质斧：每棵树每刻最多砍几根
Range: 1 ~ 128

general.essential_tools.logs_per_tick_to.comment:
Axe: most logs all fellings together cut per tick.
源质斧：全部正在砍的树每刻合计最多砍几根
Range: 1 ~ 1024

general.essential_tools.max_logs.comment:
Axe: most logs cut from one tree, the one you chop included (the largest vanilla trees have about 100).
源质斧：一棵树最多砍几根（含你亲手砍的那根；原版最大的树约 100 根）
Range: 1 ~ 1024

general.essential_tools.max_mru.comment:
MRU stored by each tool. Takes effect on tools created afterwards; existing ones are clamped to the new capacity.
每把工具自带多少 MRU（新建出来的工具按新值算，已有的存量按新容量截断）
Range: 1 ~ 100000000

general.essential_tools.max_scan.comment:
Axe: most blocks looked at when finding the tree (once per chop).
源质斧：找树时最多看几格（每砍一次找一次）
Range: 64 ~ 8192

general.essential_tools.mru_per_block.comment:
MRU the pickaxe spends per block it breaks, the one you mine included. The tool mines fast only while it holds at least this much itself.
源质镐每拆成一格（含你亲手挖的那格）扣多少 MRU；工具自己存的不到这个数时挖得很慢
Range: 0 ~ 10000

general.essential_tools.mru_per_log.comment:
MRU the axe spends per log it cuts, the one you chop included. The tool chops fast only while it holds at least this much itself.
源质斧每砍成一根（含你亲手砍的那根）扣多少 MRU；工具自己存的不到这个数时砍得很慢
Range: 0 ~ 10000

general.give_research_book_on_first_join.comment:
Give every player a Research Book (a step-by-step tutorial) the first time they join.
玩家第一次进服时送一本研究手册（流程教程），每人只送一次

general.guns.lens_corrosion_ticks.comment:
Chaos lens: each hit that lands gives the target Corrosion (cannot heal) for this many ticks (20 = 1 second). 0 = off.
混沌透镜：每次打实给目标多少刻的腐蚀（回不了血，20 刻 = 1 秒）；0 = 关
Range: 0 ~ 1200

general.guns.lens_dispel.comment:
Magic lens: each hit that lands removes one beneficial status effect from the target (infinite ones first, then the longest).
魔力透镜：每次打实剥掉目标一个有益的状态效果（无限时长的先剥，其余剥剩余时间最长的）

general.guns.lens_drain_percent.comment:
Shade lens: each hit that lands heals the shooter by this percent of the damage actually dealt. 0 = off.
暗影透镜：每次打实，把实际造成伤害的这个百分比回给射手；0 = 关
Range: 0.0 ~ 100.0

general.guns.lens_freeze_per_hit.comment:
Frozen lens: freeze ticks added per hit that lands; at 140 the target is frozen solid like in powder snow. Freeze ticks wear off by 2 per tick and a target can take at most one hit every 10 ticks, so values of 20 or less never build up. 0 = off.
冰冻透镜：每次打实加多少冰冻刻；到 140 就像陷在细雪里一样冻僵。冰冻刻每刻退 2，同一个目标每 10 刻最多打实一下，填 20 以下永远攒不起来；0 = 关
Range: 0 ~ 200

general.guns.matrix_damage_per_damage.comment:
Matrix damage added to a survival / adventure player per point of the gun's damage whenever a ray hits them, even if the damage itself does not go through (invulnerability frames, cancelled, absorbed by armor). Hits stopped by PvP, teams or claims do not count. 0 = off.
射线打中生存 / 冒险玩家时，按枪的每点伤害加多少矩阵损伤；伤害生效没有都算（无敌时间、被取消、被护甲吸收），被 PvP、队伍、领地拦下的不算；0 = 关
Range: 0 ~ 1000

general.guns.max_targets_per_shot.comment:
At most this many creatures are hit by one shot (nearest first).
一发最多打中几个生物（近的先）
Range: 1 ~ 256

general.guns.player_damage_multiplier.comment:
Damage multiplier when a ray hits a player (mobs are not affected). Matrix damage does not use it: 0 = rays only damage the matrix.
射线打玩家的伤害倍率（打生物不受影响）；矩阵损伤不乘它：0 = 只损伤矩阵、不掉血
Range: 0.0 ~ 10.0

general.hoanna.portal_build_attempts.comment:
Spots tried when building an arrival gate in Hoanna (the last one is a forced platform); if claims deny all of them the trip is cancelled.
在海纳尔建落脚门时最多试几个位置（最后一个是强制平台）；都被领地拒绝时取消这次传送
Range: 1 ~ 32

general.hoanna.portal_cooldown_ticks.comment:
Ticks after travelling before a gate works again; it does not count down while standing in a gate.
过门后多少刻内门不再响应（站在门里期间不减，得先走出来）
Range: 20 ~ 6000

general.hoanna.portal_enabled.comment:
Whether Gates to Hoanna work in the Overworld (off: nobody can travel from the Overworld and the Wind Tablet cannot open gates; existing gates stay). Players already in Hoanna can still come back through gates when this is off, and can still mend an empty frame there with the Wind Tablet.
海纳尔之门在主世界这边是否可用（关掉后从主世界过不去、风之石板不再换门；已经换好的门留在原地）。关掉后，已经在海纳尔的人仍能从门回来，在海纳尔也仍能用风之石板补空门框

general.hoanna.portal_preload.comment:
Load the arrival area in the background while a player waits in a gate (like vanilla's portal ticket, 300 ticks).
玩家站进门开始等待时就在后台加载目的地的区块（同原版过门后的传送门票，300 刻自动过期）

general.hoanna.portal_search_radius.comment:
How far (square radius, blocks) to look for an existing gate on the other side.
在另一边找现成的门找多远（正方形半径，格）
Range: 16 ~ 128

general.hoanna.portal_wait_ticks.comment:
Ticks a player has to stand in a gate before travelling (creative: always 1).
站在门里多少刻才会过去（创造模式固定 1 刻），20 刻 = 1 秒
Range: 1 ~ 400

general.hoanna_events.chance_multiplier.comment:
Multiplier on the chance of every calamity. 0 = they never start on their own (/ec5 hoanna_event start still works).
所有天灾发生概率的倍数；0 = 不会自己发生（/ec5 hoanna_event start 照样能开）
Range: 0.0 ~ 10.0

general.hoanna_events.darkness_enabled.comment:
Darkness can happen on its own.
黑暗会不会自己发生

general.hoanna_events.earthquake_enabled.comment:
Earthquake can happen on its own.
地震会不会自己发生

general.hoanna_events.earthquake_push.comment:
Earthquakes nudge players on the ground once a second and now and then jolt them (never hard enough to cause fall damage). When off only the camera shakes.
地震每秒推一下站在地上的玩家、偶尔来一次强震（不会高到摔伤）；关掉后只剩画面晃动

general.hoanna_events.fumes_enabled.comment:
Poison fumes can happen on its own.
毒雾会不会自己发生

general.hoanna_events.fumes_max_nearby.comment:
During poison fumes, no more fumes spawn naturally once this many are within 64 blocks. 0 = no fumes spawn and the poison fumes calamity no longer starts on its own (/ec5 hoanna_event start still works).
毒雾期间，64 格内已有这么多只毒雾就不再自然生成；0 = 不刷毒雾，毒雾天灾也不再自己发生（/ec5 hoanna_event start 照样能开）
Range: 0 ~ 64

general.hoanna_events.ley_storm_chance.comment:
Chance of a ley storm at dusk on a spring-tide night (also multiplied by chance_multiplier).
大潮夜黄昏起地脉风暴的几率（还要乘 chance_multiplier）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.hoanna_events.ley_storm_enabled.comment:
Ley storm can happen on its own. It is rolled once at dusk on spring-tide nights (the three nights around the full moon); with the mana tide turned off there is no spring tide, so it never comes on its own.
地脉风暴会不会自己发生。只在大潮夜（满月前后那三夜）的黄昏掷一次；关掉魔力潮汐时没有大潮，它也就不会自己来

general.hoanna_events.ley_storm_radiatio.comment:
During a ley storm, radiation dose per second for players under the open sky. Armor can lower it to half at most. 0 = none. The storm never deals damage.
地脉风暴期间，露天每秒加多少辐射剂量；盔甲最多减到一半。0 = 不加。风暴本身不造成伤害
Range: 0 ~ 1000

general.hoanna_events.ley_storm_starfall.comment:
During a ley storm, every this many ticks each player under the open sky has a 60% chance to get a starfall nearby.
地脉风暴期间，每隔多少刻给每个露天的人掷一次（六成几率在附近落一个地脉落晶）
Range: 20 ~ 6000

During a ley storm, at most this many ley starfalls exist for each player at once. 0 = no starfalls.
地脉风暴期间，每个人名下同时最多有几个地脉落晶；0 = 不落晶
Range: 0 ~ 64

general.hoanna_events.sun_array_enabled.comment:
Sun array can happen on its own (rolled once at dawn).
日阵会不会自己发生（每天黎明掷一次）

general.hoanna_nests.max_active_per_play.comment:
A nest will not release its wave while any player in range already has this many fighting nests within 48 blocks.
附近有玩家身边 48 格内已经有这么多个正在战斗的巢穴时，新的巢穴先不放怪
Range: 1 ~ 64

general.hoanna_nests.recharge_ticks.comment:
Ticks a nest stays dormant after its wave is cleared before it can be triggered again (72000 = 3 in-game days).
A nest type's own recharge_ticks overrides this.
巢穴清完以后休眠多久才能再触发（刻，72000 = 3 个游戏日）。巢穴类型 JSON 自己写了 recharge_ticks 的以那个为准
Range: > 1

general.hoanna_nests.reset_ticks.comment:
Ticks a nest's wave may go with no survival / adventure player within its leash radius before the remaining
monsters are removed and the nest re-arms (only counted while the nest's chunk is loaded). A nest type's reset_ticks overrides this.
放出的这一波在拴绳半径内一直没有生存 / 冒险玩家多久就收回剩下的怪、重新等人（刻，只在核心所在区块加载时累计）。
巢穴类型 JSON 自己写了 reset_ticks 的以那个为准
Range: > 1

general.hoanna_survey.arrive_radius.comment:
Within this many blocks (horizontal) of the marked spot, you've arrived: the map unmarks it and skips it next time.
离标的点水平距离在多少格以内算到了：图上去掉这一处，下次找下一处
Range: 4 ~ 256

general.hoanna_survey.search_radius.comment:
How far the map looks for the nearest site, in blocks (horizontal). It never loads chunks; every search shares one server-wide budget per tick.
勘测图往外找多远（水平半径，格）。找的时候不加载区块，全服每刻共用一份预算
Range: 128 ~ 8192

general.hoanna_tide.enabled.comment:
Mana tide in Hoanna: the tide level follows the moon phase (full moon 1.0, new moon 0) and drives tide bud growth,
ley storms, the MRU veil in the sky, local monster weights and collapse speed. false = the tide stays at 0.5: no spring tides
and no ley storms, tide buds grow every night at 3/8 of the chance instead (same average yield), and the veil, monster weights
and collapse speed stay at x1. Hoanna shares the overworld's day: skipping the night by sleeping in the overworld skips it there too.
海纳尔的魔力潮汐：潮位跟着月相走（满月 1.0、新月 0），影响潮晶芽生长、地脉风暴、天上的 MRU 光幕、本地怪权重、坍缩速度；
关掉时潮位恒为 0.5：没有大潮和地脉风暴；潮晶芽改为每个夜里都长、几率 ×3/8（平均产量不变）；光幕、本地怪权重、坍缩速度都按 ×1。
海纳尔和主世界共用昼夜：主世界有人睡觉跳过夜晚时，海纳尔的夜也一起跳过

general.hoanna_world.radiant_mining_dose.comment:
Radiation dose added to a player who mines a radiant cluster in Hoanna, multiplied by their radiation vulnerability but never by less than 0.5. 0 = no dose.
在海纳尔里挖掉一块辐晶簇时挖的人加的剂量，乘他的辐射易伤（易伤低于 0.5 按 0.5 算）；0 = 不加
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

general.hoanna_world.tide_bud.growth_cha.comment:
Chance per random tick to grow one stage when every condition is met. 0 = never grows.
条件都满足时每次随机刻长一阶的几率；0 = 不长
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.hoanna_world.umbral.day_chance.comment:
Chance to get one umbral crystal when harvesting during the day (at night or during Darkness you always get 1 to 2).
白天收取时得 1 个影晶的几率（夜里或黑暗天灾中固定得 1~2 个）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.hoanna_world.umbral.regrow_chanc.comment:
Chance per random tick for a harvested cluster to ripen again (only in the Shadow Corrupted Land, at night or during Darkness). The default takes about one night. 0 = never grows back.
残簇每次随机刻长回成熟的几率（只在暗影腐化之地、夜里或黑暗天灾中）；默认大约一夜长回；0 = 不再长回
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.hoanna_world.vent.charge_chance_.comment:
Chance per random tick to gain one charge during an earthquake or a ley storm.
地震或地脉风暴中每次随机刻充一格的几率
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

Chance per random tick to gain one charge during the day.
白天每次随机刻充一格的几率
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

Chance per random tick to gain one charge at night (time of day 13000 to 23000).
夜里（一天的 13000~23000 刻）每次随机刻充一格的几率
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

general.hoanna_world.vent.crystals_per_c.comment:
Ley crystals given per charge when collected. 0 = vents give nothing.
收取时每格换几个地脉结晶；0 = 喷口什么都不给
Range: 0 ~ 16

general.hoanna_world.vent.max_charge.comment:
A vent stops charging at this many charges.
喷口充到几格就不再充
Range: 1 ~ 3

general.holo_decoy.boss_ticks.comment:
Bosses (#forge:bosses) only fall for decoys for this many ticks; then no one's decoy fools that boss again until max(cooldown_ticks, boss_ticks) ticks after it was first fooled. 0 = bosses ignore decoys.
Boss（#forge:bosses）最多被骗多少刻；从它上当算起 max(cooldown_ticks, boss_ticks) 刻内谁的诱饵都不再骗它；0 = Boss 不上当
Range: 0 ~ 6000

general.holo_decoy.cooldown_ticks.comment:
Cooldown after each decoy, in ticks (20 = 1 second), shared by all projectors and kept across relogs. 0 = no cooldown.
每投一次的冷却（刻，20 = 1 秒），所有投影仪共用，退出重进不清；0 = 没有冷却
Range: 0 ~ 72000

general.holo_decoy.lifetime_ticks.comment:
How long a decoy lasts, in ticks.
诱饵存在多少刻
Range: 20 ~ 6000

general.holo_decoy.max_range.comment:
Farthest distance, in blocks, the decoy can be projected in front of you.
诱饵最远投到准星前多少格
Range: 1 ~ 16

general.holo_decoy.mru_per_use.comment:
MRU spent per decoy (taken from MRU storages you carry first, then from the projector itself; the projector holds 20000). Spent only when the decoy appears.
每投一个诱饵花多少 MRU（先扣身上的储存物品，凑不够再扣投影仪自己存的；投影仪最多存 20000）。诱饵出来了才扣
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

general.holo_decoy.radius.comment:
Hostile mobs within this many blocks of the decoy that are after you (or a teammate) turn on the decoy.
诱饵周围多少格内、正盯着你（或同队玩家）的敌对生物会改去打诱饵
Range: 1 ~ 32

general.hologram.abandon_ticks.comment:
Ticks with nobody fighting before it shuts down (a holopad-summoned one drops its holopad back).
Also: a fighter beyond the pull-back distance who can't be pulled back (spot blocked, not allowed to build there, teleport stopped)
for this long in a row leaves the fight.
没人参战多少 tick 后它消失（投影台召出来的掉回投影台）。
参战者在拉回距离以外、连着这么久拉不回来（落点被堵、他在落点没有权限、传送被拦），也按脱战移出
Range: 100 ~ 72000

general.hologram.clone_max_attack_damage.comment:
Most attack damage of a player clone (3 + the copied weapon; before difficulty scaling).
玩家克隆体的攻击力上限（3 + 被复制的武器加成；难度缩放之前）
Range: 1.0 ~ 100.0

general.hologram.escape_range.comment:
A fighter farther than this (blocks) leaves the fight; between 24 and this they are pulled back.
参战者离它超过几格就脱战；24 格到这个距离之间会被拉回
Range: 24 ~ 256

general.hologram.max_armor_destroyers.comment:
Most armor destroyers in flight at once per Holographic Projection.
每只全息投影同时最多几发护甲破坏者
Range: 0 ~ 256

general.hologram.max_clones.comment:
Most player clones alive at once per Holographic Projection.
每只全息投影同时最多几只玩家克隆体
Range: 0 ~ 64

general.hologram.max_damage_per_hit.comment:
Most damage it takes from a single hit (0 = no cap, as original).
它一下最多挨多少伤害（0 = 不封顶，同原作）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1024.0

general.hologram.max_dividers.comment:
Most divider fields at once per Holographic Projection.
每只全息投影同时最多几个二分场
Range: 0 ~ 64

general.hologram.max_health.comment:
Max health of a Holographic Projection (400 = original). Applies to newly summoned ones.
全息投影的最大生命（原作 400）。只对新召出来的生效
Range: 1.0 ~ 1024.0

general.hologram.orbital_max_damage.comment:
Cap of the doubling orbital strikes of its multiplication attack (1024 = original, 1 doubling to 512).
乘法攻击里轨道打击每发翻倍的封顶（1024 = 原作，从 1 翻到 512）
Range: 1.0 ~ 1024.0

general.hologram.other_dimensions.comment:
Allow summoning outside Hoanna (holopad and spawn egg; original AllowHologramInOtherDimensions).
海纳尔以外的维度也能召唤（投影台和刷怪蛋；原作 AllowHologramInOtherDimensions）

general.homeward_compass.allow_cross_dim.comment:
If false, the compass only takes you home within the same dimension.
假：只能回同一个维度里的归途点

general.homeward_compass.base_mru.comment:
Base MRU for a trip within the same dimension. All MRU comes from storages you carry.
同维度传送的起价（MRU），全从身上的储存物品扣
Range: 0 ~ 10000000

general.homeward_compass.channel_ticks.comment:
How long you hold right-click before you're sent home, in ticks (20 = 1 second).
要按住右键引导多少刻才传走（20 = 1 秒）
Range: 20 ~ 600

general.homeward_compass.combat_lock_tic.comment:
After you're hit by any mob or player, you can't start a trip for this many ticks.
被任何生物（含玩家）打过以后多少刻内不能起手
Range: 0 ~ 6000

general.homeward_compass.cooldown_ticks.comment:
Cooldown after a trip within the same dimension, in ticks. Kept across relogs, cleared on death.
同维度传送成功后的冷却（刻）；退出重进不清，死亡清掉
Range: 0 ~ 72000

general.homeward_compass.cross_dimension.comment:
Cooldown after a trip to another dimension, in ticks.
跨维度传送成功后的冷却（刻）
Range: 0 ~ 144000

MRU for a trip to another dimension (flat price).
跨维度传送花多少 MRU（一口价）
Range: 0 ~ 1000000000

general.homeward_compass.denied_target_d.comment:
Dimensions the compass can't take you into from another dimension. Trips within one of them still work.
不能从别的维度传进去的维度；已经在里面时，在里面传不受限

general.homeward_compass.enabled.comment:
If false, the compass can't start a trip home (binding still works).
假：罗盘不能起手（绑定照样能绑）

general.homeward_compass.max_mru_same_di.comment:
Cap on the MRU for a trip within the same dimension.
同维度传送最多花多少 MRU
Range: 0 ~ 100000000

general.homeward_compass.move_tolerance.comment:
Moving farther than this many blocks from where you started (straight-line distance) breaks the channel.
引导中离起点超过多少格（直线距离）就打断
Range: 0.5 ~ 8.0

general.homeward_compass.mru_per_block.comment:
Extra MRU per block of horizontal distance (rounded up) within the same dimension.
同维度每格水平距离（向上取整）另加多少 MRU
Range: 0 ~ 10000

general.inquisitorium.arrive_radius.comment:
Horizontal distance to the coordinates that counts as arrived; the beacon must be placed this close too.
离坐标水平多近算到了；审判庭信标也要放在这么近以内
Range: 4 ~ 256

general.inquisitorium.balance_max.comment:
Highest target balance written on a Glitchy Core.
故障核心上的目标平衡值最高多少
Range: 0.0 ~ 2.0

general.inquisitorium.balance_min.comment:
Lowest target balance written on a Glitchy Core.
故障核心上的目标平衡值最低多少
Range: 0.0 ~ 2.0

general.inquisitorium.decode_mru.comment:

每 tick 最多换多少 MRU（大于 max_mru 时按 max_mru 算）；0 = 这一档不输出
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

machines.mru_converter.enabled.comment:
Whether MRU converters (all tiers, including the infinite one) work at all.
MRU 转换器（各档，含无尽档）是否工作

machines.mru_converter.fe_per_1000_mru.comment:
FE (Forge Energy) made from every 1000 MRU; 0 = no energy output. For reference, Botania's Mana Fluxfield turns 1 mana into 10 FE.
每 1000 MRU 换多少 FE（Forge 能量）；0 = 不出能量。参考：植物魔法的魔力通量场 1 魔力 = 10 FE
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

machines.mru_converter.generate_corrupti.comment:
Whether survival-tier converters leak MRU into nearby MRUCUs while working (the infinite one never does).
生存档转换器工作时是否向周围泄漏 MRU（无尽档永远不漏）

machines.mru_converter.infinite.max_mru_.comment:
The infinite converter uses no MRU; it outputs as much as converting this much MRU per tick would. 0 = it outputs nothing.
无尽转换器不耗 MRU，按每 tick 换这么多 MRU 的量输出；0 = 不输出
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

machines.mru_converter.mana_per_1000_mru.comment:
Botania mana made from every 1000 MRU; 0 = no mana output (mana mode also needs Botania installed).
每 1000 MRU 换多少植物魔法的魔力；0 = 不出魔力（魔力模式还要装了植物魔法）
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

machines.mru_converter.max_corruption_ge.comment:
Max MRU leaked per 20 working ticks (a random amount from 0 to this).
每工作 20 tick 最多泄漏多少 MRU（在 0 到这个值之间随机）
Range: 0 ~ 10000

machines.mru_converter.max_per_owner.comment:
How many converters of the same owner work at the same time across the server, all tiers together including the infinite one (only loaded ones count; the earliest placed ones work; 0 = no limit).
同一个主人全服同时有几台转换器能工作，各档和无尽档一起数（只数加载着的，按放下的先后取最早的几台；0 = 不限）
Range: 0 ~ 1024

machines.mru_converter.mithriline.max_mr.comment:
MRU capacity.
MRU 容量
Range: > 1

Max MRU converted per tick (above max_mru counts as max_mru); 0 = this tier outputs nothing.
每 tick 最多换多少 MRU（大于 max_mru 时按 max_mru 算）；0 = 这一档不输出
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

machines.mru_converter.pale.max_mru.comment:
MRU capacity.
MRU 容量
Range: > 1

machines.mru_converter.pale.max_mru_per_.comment:
Max MRU converted per tick (above max_mru counts as max_mru); 0 = this tier outputs nothing.
每 tick 最多换多少 MRU（大于 max_mru 时按 max_mru 算）；0 = 这一档不输出
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

machines.mru_presence.block_resistances.comment:
MRU resistance of blocks between an MRUCU and a player, as "namespace:block=resistance".
A player is affected with a chance of 1/floor(max resistance along the line); unlisted blocks count as 1.
Entries for blocks that do not exist (yet) are ignored.
MRU 聚集体到玩家之间方块的 MRU 抗性，格式「命名空间:方块=抗性」。
玩家受影响的概率是 1/⌊连线上的最大抗性⌋，没列出的方块算 1；不存在（还没移植）的方块会被忽略。

machines.natural_furnace.balance.comment:
Balance of the MRU produced. -1 = random in [0, 2), rolled once when the furnace is placed.
产出 MRU 的平衡值。-1 表示放下时在 [0, 2) 里随机一次（冰冻、混沌 MRU 的来源，别轻易改）
Range: -1.0 ~ 2.0

machines.natural_furnace.mru_generated.comment:
MRU per tick while burning a plant.
烧植物时每 tick 的产量
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

machines.natural_furnace.ticks_flower.comment:
Ticks one flower burns. 0 = flowers are not accepted.
一朵花烧多少 tick；0 表示不收花
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

machines.natural_furnace.ticks_grass.comment:
Ticks one grass/fern burns. 0 = grass is not accepted.
一丛草（蕨）烧多少 tick；0 表示不收草
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

machines.natural_furnace.ticks_sapling.comment:
Ticks one sapling burns. 0 = saplings are not accepted.
一株树苗烧多少 tick；0 表示不收树苗
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

machines.potion_spreader.forbidden_effec.comment:
Potions with any of these effects cannot be put into the spreader.
Instant harmful effects (Instant Damage) are always forbidden.
含有这些效果的药水不能放进扩散器。瞬间且有害的效果（瞬间伤害）无论如何都不能放

machines.potion_spreader.generate_corrup.comment:
Whether the spreader leaks MRU into nearby MRUCUs while working.
工作时是否向周围泄漏 MRU

machines.potion_spreader.max_corruption_.comment:
Max MRU leaked each time an effect is given (a random amount from 0 to this).
每加上一次效果最多泄漏多少 MRU（在 0 到这个值之间随机）
Range: 0 ~ 10000

machines.potion_spreader.max_spread_amou.comment:
How many times one potion can be spread.
一瓶药水能扩散几次
Range: 1 ~ 10000

machines.potion_spreader.mru_usage.comment:
MRU used each time one effect is given to one creature.
每给一个生物加上一种效果消耗的 MRU
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

machines.radiating_chamber.generate_corr.comment:
Whether the chamber leaks MRU into nearby MRUCUs while working.
工作时是否向附近的 MRU 聚集体泄漏 MRU

machines.radiating_chamber.max_corruptio.comment:
Max MRU leaked per working tick (a random amount from 0 to this).
每个工作 tick 最多泄漏多少 MRU（在 0 到这个值之间随机）
Range: 0 ~ 10000

machines.radiating_chamber.mru_usage_mod.comment:
MRU used per working tick = this × the recipe's cost modifier (rounded down).
工作时每 tick 耗能 = 这个值 × 配方的耗能倍率（向下取整）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1000000.0

machines.reactor.balance.comment:
Balance of the generated MRU; -1 cycles between 0 and 2 by 0.01 per tick.
产出 MRU 的平衡值；-1 表示每刻变 0.01、在 0 和 2 之间来回摆
Range: -1.0 ~ 2.0

machines.reactor.damage.comment:
Damage per zap (MRU discharge: ignores armor points, mobs killed by it drop nothing).
每次电击的伤害（MRU 电弧：无视护甲值，被它打死的生物不掉落）
Range: 0.0 ~ 1000.0

machines.reactor.damage_interval.comment:
Ticks between zaps (the original hit every tick, but invulnerability frames limited it to one hit per 10 ticks).
两次电击之间隔几刻（原作每刻都打，但受伤无敌帧让它实际 10 刻才生效一次）
Range: 1 ~ 200

machines.reactor.damage_mobs.comment:
Zap hostile mobs within 3 blocks.
电 3 格内的敌对生物

machines.reactor.max_targets.comment:
Maximum mobs hurt by one zap.
一次电击最多打几只
Range: 1 ~ 256

machines.reactor.mru_generated.comment:
MRU generated per tick while the structure is complete.
结构完整时每刻产出的 MRU
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

machines.redstone_transmitter.update_int.comment:
How often (in ticks) a redstone transmitter re-reads the signal at the transmitter its bound gem points to.
红石传递器每隔多少刻重读一次绑定宝石指向的那个传递器收到的信号
Range: 1 ~ 20

machines.shearing_station.max_per_pulse.comment:
At most this many creatures are sheared per redstone pulse.
每次红石脉冲最多剪几只
Range: 1 ~ 128

machines.shearing_station.pulse_interval.comment:
Minimum ticks between two redstone pulses (a pulse inside the interval waits for it to end).
Not below 10: every pulse queries all creatures in a 25x25x25 area.
两次红石脉冲之间至少隔几刻（间隔内来的脉冲等间隔结束再做）；每次脉冲都要查 25×25×25 的生物，所以不低于 10
Range: 10 ~ 1200

machines.solar_prism.burn_players.comment:
Beams only burn hostile mobs. Turn this on to also burn players near the landing spot, like the original mod
(the fire has no attacker, so PvP settings and claims cannot stop it).
光束只烧敌对生物。打开后落点附近的玩家也烧，同原作（火焰伤害没有攻击者，PvP 开关和领地都拦不住）

machines.solar_prism.ignore_rain.comment:
Whether beams also fire while it rains.
下雨时是否照样出光束

machines.solar_prism.requires_midday.comment:
Whether beams only fire around midday (day time 5000-7000).
是否只在正午前后（一天中的时间 5000~7000）出光束

machines.solar_prism.requires_unobstruct.comment:
Whether the prism must see the sky.
棱镜正上方是否必须看得到天空

machines.solar_prism.solar_beam_chance.comment:
Chance each tick to fire a solar beam while the conditions hold.
条件满足时每刻打出一道太阳光束的几率
Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

machines.sun_ray_absorber.balance.comment:
Balance of the MRU produced (2.0 = chaos).
产出 MRU 的平衡值（2.0 为混沌）
Range: 0.0 ~ 2.0

machines.sun_ray_absorber.mru_generated.comment:
MRU per tick while a solar beam hits the absorber.
被太阳光束照到时每刻的产量
Range: 0 ~ 1000000

machines.ultra_heat_generator.balance.comment:
Balance of the MRU produced. -1 = random in [0, 2), rolled once when the generator is placed.
产出 MRU 的平衡值。-1 表示放下时在 [0, 2) 里随机一次（冰冻、混沌 MRU 的来源，别轻易改）
Range: -1.0 ~ 2.0

machines.ultra_heat_generator.max_heat.comment:
Highest heat (degrees) the generator can reach. 0 = no limit, as in the original.
Lowering it caps output at once; stored heat is kept and comes back if the limit is raised.
温度上限（度）；0 表示不封顶（同原作）。调低后产量立刻按上限算，存着的温度不丢，上限调回去就恢复
Range: > 0

machines.ultra_heat_generator.max_mru.comment:
MRU capacity (the original hard-coded 10 times the generic generator capacity).
MRU 容量（原作写死通用产能器的 10 倍）
Range: > 1
